POLICY SUPPORT  India has signed an FTA with the UAE which will further boost exports and is expected to reach the target of US$ 52 billion.  The Government has reduced custom duty on cut and polished diamond and colored gemstones from 7.5% to 5% and NIL.
Growth & demand: 1,600 crore (US$ 214 million) in FY22 to launch 56 stores, of which 40 would be in India and 16 across global markets.

GROWTH DRIVERS OF MEDIA AND ENTERTAINMENT SECTOR IN INDIA: GROWING DEMAND  India's gems and jewellery exports reached US$ 39.14 billion in 2021-22, a 54.13% rise from the previous year.  India ranks first among the top exporters in cut & polished diamonds, and second in gold jewellery, silver jewellery and lab-grown diamonds.

ATTRACTIVE OPPORTUNITIES  India's gold demand stood at 797.30 tonnes in 2021 and is expected to be in a range of 800-850 tonnes by 2022.  In the fourth quarter of 2021 demand for gold rose by 93% YoY to 265 tonnes.
